paragraphs.text: This second blessing was to confirm Jacob's faith, lest he should think that his father had given it without God's leading.

paragraphs.text: The godly fathers were continually reminded that they were but strangers in this world: so that they would lift up their eyes to the heavens where they have a certain dwelling.

paragraphs.text: Thinking by this to have reconciled himself to his father, but all in vain: for he does not take away the cause of the evil.

paragraphs.text: Christ is the ladder by which God and man are joined together, and by whom the angels minister to us: all graces are given to us by him, and we ascend to heaven by him.
